text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, looking toward the track,
Vodka and that junior from before
were hard at work training.

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*—Vodka-san!
How was that run just now?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That was pretty good!
...And so, uhh.

text_block_list.name: Inner Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Bwahahaha!
Her physique dashes as if dancing, perfectly balanced!
Then, the words to guide her toward her next voyage are—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Gim-senpai, hold up!
Can I... try figuring out the rest myself?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Talking with you, Senpai...
I feel like I'm starting to get how to put it into words.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Tuning... tuning...
—Say it like this... and then like this...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
—Alright!
Overall, your body balance has come together!
Time to switch to a menu suited for real racing.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
From here on, it's practical combat!
Let's run a mock race against me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Let's do this, Vodka-san!
choice_data_list: (She's really shaping up for the race.)
(She's really shaping up for the race.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, race day arrived.
I was curious myself, so I joined Vodka to watch her junior's run.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Haha, it's finally time! How are ya feeling?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: ...Yes! Perfectly fine!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. ...I'm... fine...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(Damn, she looks super anxious.
Even after all that special training we did together... she must feel totally alone out there...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Sheesh. Quit worrying already.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Once you step onto that course, you'll be on your own, but—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You've got me in your corner!!
I'll be right here watching over your whole damn race!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hit 'em hard! Crank that engine to full throttle!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text: !! ...YES, MA'AM!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Give it everything you've got~! Tear it up out there~!
choice_data_list: That was a really kind and spot-on pep talk!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heheh, hell yeah!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —...Wait... huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: D-Did I... just do that... all on my own without choking up?!
—...Sublime taste.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?
—A truly crystal-clear cup.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: —She's fast, she's so fast, the lead is widening more and more!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
A rising star with undeniable talent!!
Pulling away with unbelievable speed, she takes wire-to-wire GOAAAL!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
ALRIGHT!! HELL YEAAAH!!
Awesome!! You were freakin' awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka's Junior
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san... Vodka-saaan!
Thank you sooo much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later. I saw Vodka thanking Tanino Gimlet profusely.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai!!
Thank you so damn much for watching over me lately!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? I cannot fathom precisely what you mean, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The exquisite vintage forever engraved upon one's palate is none other than I! Intoxicate yourself at all times! Hahahahaha!
